meta.purpose: What must be answered before a decision can reasonably be made. Each question separates what we know, what we do not know, and how to find the missing piece. Nothing here is rhetorical: every question has an owner and a way to close it.

legend.blocks: What decision this question is holding up.
legend.known: Established in this session from a retrievable source.
legend.unknown: Not established. Do not act as though it is.
legend.to_close: The specific step that would answer it.

questions.question: Which product is behind the fifth submitted link?
questions.blocks: Any page, table row or recommendation for that product. Also any claim about the 'five products'.
questions.known: The link https://link.amazon/B0c8moW59 returns Amazon's interstitial 'Continue shopping' page at /checkpoint/continue. It was requested twice on 2026-11-20 with the same result.
questions.unknown: The product name, ASIN, category and any attribute. Nothing is inferred.
questions.to_close: Open the link in a browser on the owner's own network, or send the full amazon.com/dp/ URL. Either produces the ASIN as a stated fact.

questions.question: Are the supplied short links valid Associates links for this account?
questions.blocks: Driving traffic. Attribution. The whole commercial premise.
questions.known: Four of the five resolved to real product pages. None of the four observed redirect targets contained a tag parameter. Amazon's policy requires the Associates ID to appear as a parameter in each link URL.
questions.unknown: Whether attribution happens through a mechanism we cannot see from the redirect, and whether these links were generated in the Associates account for tag shopnow047c-20 at all.
questions.to_close: Generate one link in SiteStripe for a known product, compare the resulting URL with the supplied short link, then click the supplied link once and look for a click in the Associates report.

questions.question: Is the account enrolled, and does 'shopnow047c-20' belong to it?
questions.blocks: Publishing paid links at all. Amazon permits Special Links only after applying, and only using the Associates ID assigned to you.
questions.known: The operator supplied the tracking ID shopnow047c-20 and it matches the XXXXX-## format named in the policies.
questions.unknown: Whether the account is approved, whether the tag is active, and which site is registered against it.
questions.to_close: Sign in to the Associates dashboard and confirm the tag against the registered site URL.

questions.question: What is the commercial goal, and what number would count as success?
questions.blocks: Every prioritisation decision, including which guides to write next and whether to fund original photography or testing.
questions.known: There is no stated revenue target, no conversion baseline and no traffic baseline. None was measured and none is invented here.
questions.unknown: Target commissions, acceptable payback period on content, and whether the owner intends to treat this as a business or a demonstration.
questions.to_close: Owner states one number and a date.

questions.question: Does anyone actually search for these questions?
questions.blocks: The whole content plan. Guides were chosen on editorial judgement, not on volume data.
questions.known: Six guides exist because they map to genuine buying decisions. That is an argument about usefulness, not about demand.
questions.unknown: Impressions, clicks, search volume, competition, and which of the six would rank first.
questions.to_close: Verify the property in Search Console, submit the sitemap, and read queries after 4 to 6 weeks. Or use a keyword tool and record the date and the figures.

questions.question: Where will analytics be collected, and under what privacy posture?
questions.blocks: Every optimisation decision after launch. Also the content of the privacy page.
questions.known: The site now emits five defined events to a documented interface. No collector exists, so nothing is being recorded.
questions.unknown: Hosting for the endpoint, retention period, whether IP addresses are stored, and which jurisdictions the audience sits in.
questions.to_close: Choose a host, decide whether to store IPs (we recommend hashing or discarding), then point ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT at it.

questions.question: Does the product data path require API access, and is the account eligible?
questions.blocks: Any plan to show live prices, availability, ratings or images.
questions.known: PA-API 5 is deprecated in favour of the Creators API. Images and price data may only be used through the licensed tools.
questions.unknown: Eligibility thresholds for Creators API access. Secondary sources state a sales threshold, but that was not confirmed in a document retrieved from Amazon, so it is not published as fact.
questions.to_close: Read the Creators API introduction and FAQ while signed in, and record the stated eligibility rule with the date it was read.

questions.question: Is there any original testing, or is every claim second-hand?
questions.blocks: The strength of every recommendation. Also whether the site can ever claim a defensible advantage over Amazon's own reviews.
questions.known: No product on this desk has been physically tested. The site says so in the editorial standards and in each guide.
questions.unknown: Whether budget exists to buy units, and whether the owner can publish measured results lawfully.
questions.to_close: Decide whether to fund a test unit. If yes, publish method and measurements. If no, keep the current explicit disclosure.

questions.question: Who is legally responsible for the site, and what jurisdiction governs it?
questions.blocks: The privacy page, the contact page and the complaints path.
questions.known: The site is published from a public GitHub repository under an individual account.
questions.unknown: Business entity, contact address, governing law, and whether any jurisdictions beyond the US are targeted.
questions.to_close: Owner supplies an entity name and a contact route.

questions.question: Can the site show a delivery estimate or availability?
questions.known: Amazon permits price and availability display only when Amazon serves the link or the data comes through the API.
questions.unknown: Nothing material. This one is closed as: no, not without API access.
questions.to_close: Closed. Recorded here so it is not re-litigated.

questions.question: Should the site carry a second category beyond air fryers?
questions.blocks: The recommendation, the navigation and the design language.
questions.known: Four of five products are countertop cooking appliances with one thermometer. That is coherent as a single desk.
questions.unknown: Whether the owner has more products in other categories, and whether a narrow desk or a broad catalogue is the intent.

questions.question: How will corrections be made after launch?
questions.blocks: Long-term trust, and the ability to comply with the accuracy requirement in the Program Policies.
questions.known: A correction policy is published. There is no automated change-detection yet.
questions.unknown: How often product listings change out from under the written copy, because nothing is watching them.
questions.to_close: Add a scheduled job that re-checks each product page and opens an issue when a listing no longer matches the stored attributes.
